description: This release brings major offline playback improvements, a refreshed UI for Followed Artists, and a much smoother in-app update experience.

changelog.title: Features & Improvements
items: Offline playback: Fully cached songs can now be played entirely offline without requiring a network connection
Followed Artists: Refreshed the search bar to dynamically expand inside the TopAppBar for a cleaner look
Spotify Import: Simplified placeholder text to improve readability across different languages

changelog.title: Bug Fixes
items: Updater: Tapping the 'Update Available' notification now securely opens the in-app update screen instead of throwing a browser 404 error
Updater: GitHub release notes are now beautifully parsed and stripped of raw markdown bullet points for a cleaner changelog
UI: Fixed a frustrating double-padding gap issue on the Followed Artists list
